annotations.title: Advise where to list an item

description: Answer "where should I sell this?" for one item. For each US marketplace: whether it accepts the item under its published policies (prohibited and restricted items, condition rules, approval-only categories), the fees and profit at the expected price, the lowest price that meets an optional profit goal, and when the seller gets paid. Every rule cites the official page. Returns picks (highest profit, best margin, fastest payout), ranked marketplaces, ones needing approval, and excluded ones with reasons. If a marketplace's policy doesn't clearly cover the item, it's marked unclear and excluded (treated as not permitted); tell the user to check the linked policy. Doesn't model demand or the price buyers will pay.

attributes.description: Facts that change eligibility. Etsy only accepts handmade, seller-designed, vintage (20+ years) or craft supplies.

detail.description: summary (default) returns totals and fee lines; full returns the complete REST response.

estimated_sales_tax.description: Sales tax collected from the buyer, in USD (some marketplaces charge fees on it). Default 0.

expected_price.description: Expected sale price in USD. Give this, expected_prices or goal.

fulfillment_date.description: amazon_fba only: ship date (YYYY-MM-DD) that selects the FBA rate card. Defaults to today (UTC). Range 2026-01-15 to 2027-10-14.

goal.description: Optional: exactly one of profit (USD), margin_percent or roi_percent.

item_cost.description: Seller's cost of the item, in USD. Default 0.

item_type.description: clothing (Tops, dresses, jeans, jackets, activewear); kids_clothing (Children's and infant apparel); shoes (Boots, heels, sandals, dress shoes); sneakers (Athletic and lifestyle sneakers); handbags (Handbags, totes, backpacks, designer bags); accessories (Belts, wallets, hats, scarves, sunglasses); jewelry (Fine and fashion jewelry); watches (Analog and digital wristwatches (smartwatches count as electronics)); beauty_cosmetics (Makeup, skincare, hair care); fragrance (Perfume, cologne); vitamins_supplements (Vitamins, protein powder, dietary supplements); electronics (Phones, tablets, laptops, headphones, cameras, smartwatches, consoles); video_games_media (Video games, DVDs, Blu-rays, CDs, vinyl); books (Books, textbooks, comics); toys (Toys, board games, LEGO, dolls); trading_cards (Sports and trading card game cards, graded cards); home_decor (Decor, kitchenware, bedding, lamps); furniture (Chairs, tables, dressers, shelving); sporting_goods (Fitness, outdoor, camping, team sports equipment); art (Paintings, prints, sculpture, photography)

marketplaces.description: Limit to these marketplaces. Default: all. amazon_fba and walmart_wfs are skipped unless package is given.

other_costs.description: Other per-item costs (packaging, ads, etc.), in USD. Default 0.

overrides.description: Per-marketplace category, options or shipping values, e.g. {"ebay": {"options": {"store_subscription": "basic"}}, "etsy": {"options": {"offsite_ads_percent": 15}}}.
